description: Rishta Lentil Noodles Lebanese is a heartwarming and nutritious dish, combining tender green or brown lentils with flat pasta noodles and beautifully caramelized onions. This traditional Middle Eastern comfort food is often enjoyed during cooler months, offering a delightful blend of savory, earthy, and slightly tangy flavors. It is a wholesome and satisfying meal that truly embodies the essence of Lebanese home cooking.

instructions.title: Cook the Lentils
instructions.text: Rinse the lentils thoroughly under cold water. In a large pot, combine the rinsed lentils with 6 cups of water. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes, or until the lentils are tender but still hold their shape. Drain any excess water if necessary, but keep a little liquid with the lentils.

instructions.title: Caramelize the Onions
instructions.text: While the lentils are cooking, heat 1/2 cup of olive oil in a large skillet or separate pot over medium heat. Add the thinly sliced onions and cook, stirring occasionally, for 15-20 minutes until they are deeply golden brown and caramelized. This step is crucial for flavor.

instructions.title: Prepare the Noodles
instructions.text: In a separate pot, cook the flat egg noodles according to package directions until al dente. Make sure not to overcook them as they will be combined with the lentils. Drain the noodles well and set aside.

instructions.title: Sauté Garlic and Spices
instructions.text: Once the onions are caramelized, add the minced garlic to the skillet and cook for another 1-2 minutes until fragrant. Stir in the ground cumin and ground coriander, cooking for about 30 seconds to toast the spices.

instructions.title: Combine Ingredients
instructions.text: Add the cooked lentils (with their remaining liquid), the cooked and drained noodles, and the caramelized onion-garlic mixture to a large pot. Stir gently to combine all ingredients. Season with salt and black pepper to taste.

instructions.title: Finish and Serve
instructions.text: Stir in the fresh chopped cilantro and freshly squeezed lemon juice. Taste and adjust seasonings if needed. Serve hot, garnished with a drizzle of fresh olive oil and an extra sprinkle of cilantro. This dish is often enjoyed with a side of fresh vegetables or a simple salad.

tips: For truly authentic flavor, take your time caramelizing the onions until they are a rich, deep golden brown. This adds immense sweetness and depth to the dish.
If you cannot find traditional flat egg noodles, small pasta shapes like mafalda corta, fettuccine broken into smaller pieces, or even small elbow macaroni can be substituted.
Rishta is delicious served warm or at room temperature. It tends to thicken as it cools, so you might need to add a splash of hot water or vegetable broth when reheating.
